description: Sets (or deletes) env variable values for the service a project deploys. Values are stored encrypted and are never returned. Other values are kept. On a live project, the services whose env changed are redeployed; otherwise the values apply on the next deployment. Multi-line values are stored as credential files. Needs Operate access.

project.description: The project's id, name or repository (owner/name).

service.description: Service id or name, when the project has several

workspace.description: A teammate's workspace id. Default: your own.

name: set_env
title: Set env variables
